title: [CDCSDK] Crash is observed in PopulateCDCSDKIntentRecord when index is dropped on colocated DB, while CDC is streaming
body:
Jira Link: [DB-16231](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-16231)
### Description
Slack link - https://yugabyte.slack.com/archives/C03H4D4EVC6/p1744684899377419

We are observing fatal logs on `2.25.2.0-b329` with test_cdc_before_image_with_alter_table_packed_rows_rand_colocation - 
```
F20250415 15:16:19 /share/jenkins/workspace/github-yugabyte-db-alma8-master-clang19-release/yugabyte-db/src/yb/cdc/cdcsdk_producer.cc:944] Check failed: _s.ok() Bad status: Not found (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:805): Table with colocation id 3358769045 not found in Raft group 38bde5b9ca304378b3b41b74d4134b3f
    @     0x55c3fb84ecf0  google::LogMessage::SendToLog()
    @     0x55c3fb84fcbb  google::LogMessage::Flush()
    @     0x55c3fb8502b9  google::LogMessageFatal::~LogMessageFatal()
    @     0x55c3fb9f828d  yb::cdc::(anonymous namespace)::PopulateCDCSDKIntentRecord()
    @     0x55c3fb9f1806  yb::cdc::(anonymous namespace)::ProcessIntents()
    @     0x55c3fb9e21fc  yb::cdc::(anonymous namespace)::PrcoessIntentsWithInvalidSchemaRetry()
    @     0x55c3fb9dd685  yb::cdc::GetChangesForCDCSDK()
    @     0x55c3fb9884b8  yb::cdc::CDCServiceImpl::GetChanges()
    @     0x55c3fbaa1dc6  std::__1::__function::__func<>::operator()()
    @     0x55c3fbaa426f  yb::cdc::CDCServiceIf::Handle()
    @     0x55c3fcd16e22  yb::rpc::ServicePoolImpl::Handle()
    @     0x55c3fcc2b19f  yb::rpc::InboundCall::InboundCallTask::Run()
    @     0x55c3fcd24075  yb::rpc::(anonymous namespace)::Worker::Execute()
    @     0x55c3fd5f5d49  yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
    @     0x7f5d07cc51ca  start_thread
    @     0x7f5d07f16e73  __GI___clone
```
 
Here 3358769045 is colocation id of index being dropped.

```
cdc_a5b797=# SELECT tablegroup_oid, colocation_id FROM yb_table_properties('test_cdc_a3dc6a_idx_13'::regclass);
 tablegroup_oid | colocation_id 
----------------+---------------
          16643 |    3358769045
(1 row)
```
